items.title: Tony Parenti and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-06-29
items.q: I always see Raymond whenever I go down

ctx.x: Well, Merritt and Henry. No, no. Well, Merritt was a trumpet player. There's only two trombone players. George and... George came, you know, later. But Henry was the... There was two trombones that Ernest Giordina used. And that was Eddie Edwards and Henry Brunas. They were two of the kings down there. It was... You might have heard about Tom Brown, but they could never play with Giordina's band, because Giordina would play stuff out unorthodox. You understand? He played more. Brown would only play what he knew,…
